entry.title: Moonrobo Noetix URDF-reference link poses for First Trusted Square / Shackleton Rim rehearsal tile
entry.summary: noetix-e1-lab-01 review-only link pose trace has 32 frames and 25 URDF-reference links per frame; non-foot links use URDF forward kinematics, feet are contact-bound, and no hardware authority is implied
